full_prompt_en: The image is a square, tightly cropped black-and-white photograph of a woman's face beneath the brim of a textured hat. Her eyes look directly at the viewer from the upper middle of the frame. Dark eyeliner and thick lashes make the eyes exceptionally crisp; pale irises catch small reflections. The hat brim enters from the top left and stretches diagonally across the upper edge. Its closely spaced bright and dark fibers make a strong striped texture above the smoother skin. Short dark hair curls near the forehead and temple, partly tucked beneath the hat. The nose and mouth fill much of the lower half. Her lips are dark and softly parted, revealing a narrow glimpse of teeth. A small pale earring is visible beside the right ear. The face is lit from the front-left, creating a broad luminous plane across cheek and nose while the area under the hat and below the chin falls into deeper tone. Tiny freckles, pores, and photographic grain are visible across the skin, so the brightness does not become a blank smooth surface. The background is mostly lost in darkness, with a few soft shapes at the lower edges. The crop cuts off much of the hat and hair, pressing the gaze and facial planes close to the viewer. Grayscale extends from near-white highlights to black shadow, but several intermediate tones retain the skin's rounded volume. Contrast is strongest around the eyes, mouth, and striped hat edge. The image feels direct and intimate rather than distant or posed against a setting. Its style comes from the extreme proximity, luminous eyes, tactile skin and hat textures, and confident balance of high contrast with soft photographic gradation.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、裁切很紧的黑白照片，女子的脸位于一顶有肌理的帽檐之下。双眼从画面上部中央直视观者。深眼线与浓密睫毛使眼睛特别清晰；浅色虹膜接住小小反光。帽檐从左上进入，斜跨顶边。紧密排列的明暗纤维在较平滑皮肤上方形成强烈条纹肌理。短深发在额头与太阳穴附近弯曲，局部收在帽下。鼻与嘴占据下半部许多空间。嘴唇深色且轻微分开，露出窄窄一点牙齿。右耳旁有小浅色耳饰。脸由左前方照亮，颊与鼻形成宽阔明面，帽下及下巴下方则退入较深调子。皮肤上可见微小雀斑、毛孔和摄影颗粒，因此亮区并非空白光滑面。背景大多隐入黑暗，只在下方边缘留些模糊形状。裁切切掉帽子和头发的大部分，使目光与脸部平面贴近观者。灰阶从近白高光延伸到黑影，但几个中间调保留皮肤的圆润体积。反差在眼睛、嘴和条纹帽檐周围最强。图像直接而亲近，不以远距离或场景中的姿态取胜。其画风来自极近距离、发亮的眼睛、可触的皮肤与帽檐肌理，以及高对比与柔软摄影过渡之间笃定的平衡。
style_prompt_en: High-contrast monochrome photography places a sharply focused luminous area close to the picture plane. Dark framing shapes cut into the edges, while tactile woven, hairlike, and skin textures remain visible at close range. Catchlights and narrow pale edges punctuate deep surrounding shadow. Fine grain and mid-gray transitions preserve natural volume even in strong contrast. A diagonal textured border can set off the softer curves within the frame. Cropping is intimate and decisive, with little contextual background; the viewer reads gaze, surface, and light before setting. The result is direct and sensuous, combining crisp focal details with soft tonal falloff and an unmistakably photographic surface.
style_prompt_zh: 高反差黑白摄影将清晰的明亮区域推近画面平面。深色框形切入边缘，而编织物、发丝与皮肤的可触肌理仍在近距离可见。眼中光点与狭窄浅边点亮周围深影。细颗粒和中灰过渡即使在强反差中也保留自然体积。斜向带纹边缘可衬出框内柔和曲线。裁切亲密且果断，几乎没有背景语境；观者先读到目光、表面和光，再读到场景。效果直接而感官鲜明，将清脆焦点细节与柔软调子衰减和明确的摄影表面结合。
theme_en: A close black-and-white face beneath the textured edge of a hat
theme_zh: 帽檐肌理下的一张黑白近距离面孔
name: Herb Ritts
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
